aggregation: Median of 12 unfenced samples per variant/batch across four families×three repetitions; stage medians use four separately fenced diagnostic profiles (one per family). Ratios are ratios of pooled medians.

guard.metric: sum of per-process max(RSS, macOS physical footprint including compressed pages) plus full fixed MPS allocator reservation; conservative possible double counting

cache_scope: Repeated immutable source with a precomputed exact expected identity, prepared outside timing; five certified checks per case. This does not measure chronological-game cache hit rate or free identity construction after arbitrary changed states.
decision: Identity optimizations reduce complete-step GPU latency, but GPU still loses to native serial and 10-worker execution at all measured batches. Effects dominate the remaining cost; profile them before another optimization.
limits: Controlled-minor authoring fixtures followed by original legal recruitment_roll Actions, not a sampled campaign-position distribution.
Three sampled native trials and three GPU trials per case start from unchanged sources; every output is checked outside timers.
Native includes its own internal clone/validation/history/RNG and cached key guard; external input preparation/clones, locks and verification are reported separately.
GPU includes the complete resolve call; fixed arena reserve, expected-key setup, warmup and all host inspection/native verification are excluded.
Fenced stage medians are intrusive diagnostics and do not sum to unfenced whole-step medians.
No training game, learning update, network change, horizon reduction or search-budget change occurs in this experiment.
native_timer_exclusions: Owner/wrapper locks, GIL, input trial clones, full-output capture/verification, Python boxing and pool startup
native_timer_scope: Warm cached Engine key guard, original Engine.resolveChance (including its internal clone/validation/history/RNG), output Engine key; native pool dispatch included
scope: Complete supported recruitment chance transition only; not a full campaign backend, MCTS, self-play, learning or strategic-strength measurement
